name: Mizoram Sports Incentive Cash Award Scheme
benefit:
> **Incentive Cash Award:**

- Lump sum cash award to Gold, Silver, and Bronze medal winners in recognised sports disciplines.
- Applicable for National and International Championships, and Invitation Competitions/Tournaments Organized by the Recognised Federation.

- The amount of the incentive cash award will be as per the Annexure in the [Official Guidelines](https://sys.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/
_eligibility_text: - A person must be a resident of Mizoram, representing any state of the union, the Sports Control Boards, or the Country. - Winner of first, second, or third position in the specified championship as enumerated in column 3 of Annexure. - Any sports-person participating in the International Championship. - Officials, Manager, Coach, Masseur, Physiotherapist, and Doctor will also be entitled to receive 25% of the award applicable to the sports- person. - Any sports person of Mizoram representing the Country in any recognised sports discipline in any international sports or championship will be entitled to receive Rs. 20,000/- as sports kit allowance. - For the purpose of awarding the incentive cash award, there can be only one award in one sports discipline in a championship or tournament.
